item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. You've already scripted the mental reps for today — a morning reset line, a check-in on whether the moment fits the life you're building, a gut-check on whether you're mind-reading or projecting. That's the whole game today: catch the story you're telling yourself before it drives the next hour. Action: before your afternoon walk, pause and ask what you're actually assuming versus what you actually know.
